articles.headline: EU Cyber Resilience Act reporting starts with a 24-hour clock and a manual portal
articles.summary: The EU’s Cyber Resilience Act has entered its reporting phase, requiring manufacturers of products with digital elements to report actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents on a tight timeline. This raises compliance burden for companies selling connected hardware or software in Europe and increases the need for stronger vulnerability management, incident response, and documentation processes.

articles.headline: OpenAI pledged $1B to cyber defenders the same day it released Astra
articles.summary: OpenAI’s large pledge to cyber defenders, paired with the launch of its most powerful offensive model yet, underscores rising pressure on businesses to defend against more capable AI-enabled threats. For executives, this points to higher cybersecurity spending, greater model-risk scrutiny, and more aggressive attack capabilities in the market.

articles.headline: Qualcomm launches two new smartphone chips with emphasis on AI
articles.summary: Qualcomm’s new chip launch suggests continued AI feature expansion in mobile hardware, which can affect device procurement, app performance, and employee-device strategies. Businesses evaluating fleet refreshes or mobile productivity tools may need to factor in new performance and power-efficiency tradeoffs.
